Our personal injury lawyers in Fairfax have had exceptional success securing compensation for past clients, recovering over $1 billion in verdicts and settlements for our clients since 1953. Contact us today to get a better understanding of what your case could be worth. Who Is Liable in Your Personal Injury Case? Determining who’s to blame in a Fairfax personal injury case can be tricky. Virginia law applies a “contributory negligence” rule, meaning even a small degree of fault on your part can impact your claim. The responsible party could be a property owner, a driver, product manufacturers, supervisors, or even another injured person. The only way to know for sure and hold all responsible parties liable is to consult with a Fairfax attorney. Don’t navigate this legal maze alone.
